root_cause_label: Knowledge-Gap-Triggered Wrong Channel API Then Irrecoverable Debugging Spiral
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent used non-existent Jaxley channel APIs (Pas, MammalianSpike35) due to a knowledge gap about the library, then after pivoting to generic HH/Leak/CaT/CaL channels (wrong mapping for the gold test), descended into a ~50-step spiral of SWC counting and repeated failing string-replacements without ever fixing the core implementation.
t_err_evidence: Step 12: agent writes add_channels() using `self.cell.insert(jx.channels.Pas())` and `self.cell.insert(jx.channels.MammalianSpike35())` - both non-existent in Jaxley 0.10.0 - without verifying these APIs exist first; the comment 'Note: Jaxley might have a different implementation of calcium dynamics' signals the agent acted on unverified assumptions about the library.
t_commit_evidence: Step 45: after discovering the real Jaxley channels (HH, Leak, CaT, CaL), the agent rewrites add_channels() using these available channels but maps NEURON's mammalian_spike_35 parameters onto generic Pospischil-type CaT/CaL conductances (wrong equivalence for the gold solution requiring custom Ca/KCa/CaPump channels), and still uses invalid `self.cell.set('Ra', 143.2)` instead of 'axial_resistivity'. After step 45, the agent never updates jaxley_conversion.py with a correct implementation; all subsequent steps address cell initialization errors or a side test script.
t_surface_evidence: Step 47: agent interrupts (C-c) a test run and observes the full traceback showing the cell crashes at `cell.branch(i).set_ncomp()` -> `initialize()` -> `_init_solver_jaxley_dhs_solve()` with a JAX array-indexing error, confirming the cell generation fails entirely before add_channels() can even be tested.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the actual Jaxley 0.10.0 channel API. It assumed NEURON mechanism names (Pas, MammalianSpike35) would have direct Jaxley equivalents and wrote the first implementation without any prior API verification. When these were found to be absent (step 20), the agent pivoted to generic HH/Leak/CaT/CaL but still did not understand that the gold solution requires custom channel classes (Ca, KCa, CaPump, CaNernstReversal) with specific per-section conductance mappings.
forewarning_evidence: Step 13: first attempt to import jx.channels.Pas/MammalianSpike35 raises ModuleNotFoundError (wrong Python interpreter). Step 20: grep for 'MammalianSpike35' in Jaxley source returns exit code 1 (no matches), directly signaling that the channel used in add_channels() at step 12 does not exist. Step 21: grep for 'pas' also returns nothing.
